acceptance: A TPC-H SF0.01 power run on Trino and on Presto records valid platform_timing for each query, with timings within noise of a run without capture.
The chosen source and its retention limits are documented.
description:
PR #4080 defers platform-history lookups to after a power test, but system.runtime.queries keeps finished queries only briefly, so Trino/Presto set platform_history_deferrable = False and record statement IDs with status unavailable inside power tests. Run-level platform_timing coverage for these engines is therefore 0.0 for power runs.

Change. Find a source that survives the phase: an event listener or query-completed log, system.runtime.queries polled by a side connection during the run (outside the timed connection), or the coordinator's query info REST endpoint by ID. Measure that it does not change query times, then enable it.

Guardrails: linked worktree; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing; no live cloud without owner approval quoted in context; heavy runs through make heavy-run.
